# LTCme.click

> A non-custodial Litecoin web wallet with an AI assistant, wallet tools, and a transaction builder.

LTCme.click lets users import or generate Litecoin wallets, view balances, send and receive LTC, and chat with a Litecoin-focused AI. Users sign in with Google or a one-time email code before accessing wallet features. Most tools are free; paid plans add unlimited AI and advanced tools.

## Pages

- [Sign in](/auth): Continue to the wallet with Google or a one-time email code.
- [Android app](/download): Official Google Play and release-download information.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of public and authenticated routes.
